model.evidence: agent.py:13-17 MODELS = {"gpt-4o-mini": "openai", "gpt-4o": "openai", "claude-3-5-haiku-latest": "anthropic"} is where every model id this agent accepts is written down; agent.py:100-102 model = config.get("model", "gpt-4o-mini") is read by executable code and refused unless it is a key of that table; agent.py:81 branches on MODELS[model] to choose which provider client is called

prompt_style.evidence: agent.py:19-23 PROMPT_STYLES = {"plain": "Give the severity of this incident.", "step_by_step": "Work through blast radius, then customer impact, then answer.", "rubric": "Apply the rubric: SEV1 outage or data loss, SEV2 major degradation, SEV3 limited impact with a workaround, SEV4 cosmetic."} is where all three wordings this setting can select are written down; agent.py:53 PROMPT_STYLES[config.get("prompt_style", "plain")] is executable code choosing one of them for the first line of the prompt

retrieval.evidence: agent.py:25 CONTEXT_DEPTHS = (0, 2, 4) is where the three depths this setting accepts are written down; agent.py:49-51 depth = config.get("retrieval", 0) is read by executable code and refused unless it is one of them; agent.py:58 PAST_INCIDENTS[:depth] slices that many earlier incidents into the prompt, so 0 sends none and 4 sends the whole tuple declared at agent.py:27-32

output_format.evidence: agent.py:34-37 FORMAT_INSTRUCTIONS = {"label": "Answer with the severity label alone.", "json": 'Answer with {"severity": "<label>"} and nothing else.'} is where both options this setting can take are written down; agent.py:54 selects the instruction line for one of them and agent.py:66 parse_reply branches on the same setting, so the value changes both what the model is asked for and how its reply is read
